sourceSystem: FDA Adverse Event Reporting System (FAERS) via openFDA
purpose: Regression and validation reference for the pharmacovigilance listedness engine.
scope: Partial-term retrieval followed by concept validation
Conditional scenario matching including milk exposure

governance.rule: FAERS supplies real event/product anchors. Label passages are controlled fixtures designed to test listedness logic and must not be represented as original product labels.
governance.productionUse: Use for regression/reference. Product-specific production listedness must use the governed client/product/version labeling document from the knowledge base.
governance.approvalRequired: PV/medical reviewer sign-off before promotion to human-approved GOLD status.
